statements.action_statement: At main commit 503a418adf4670b665541a071e0abc8ef63a2c73, the Admin UI lockfile resolves Mermaid 12.1.0 and its transitive KaTeX 0.16.47. Upstream GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7 identifies inherited trust after pre-existing prototype pollution as the vulnerable behavior; application exploitability has not been demonstrated. This change pins KaTeX 0.18.2 and adds a regression test that rejects inherited trust. Keep this finding affected until the change passes required hosted checks and independent review, merges, and a new Admin UI release evidence bundle confirms the patched resolved artifact. Reassess the statement as fixed only against that release artifact.
